title: D'un à plusieurs : le pluriel des noms
summary: Build regular plurals, recognise common `-x` and `-aux` families, and keep ordinary family names unchanged.
objectives: Form common noun plurals and useful exceptions.
Distinguish noun endings from ordinary family surnames.

sources.label: Usito, Université de Sherbrooke: current plural sarraus, consulted 2026-09-07

sections.title: Change the article and normally add `-s`
paragraphs: Plural means more than one. `Un` and `une` normally become `des`; `le`, `la` and `l'` become `les`. The noun usually adds `-s`. This final `-s` is often silent, so listen to the article as well as the noun. A singular noun already ending in `-s`, `-x` or `-z` does not change in writing.
points: `Un sac` (m.) = a bag; `une clé` (f.) = a key; `une voix` (f.) = a voice.

mistakes.why: The written plural requires `-s` even when it is not heard.

sections.title: Use `-x` or `-aux` when the ending belongs to that family
paragraphs: Nouns in `-eau` normally add `-x`: `un bateau` (m., a boat) becomes `des bateaux`. Most nouns in `-au` and `-eu` also add `-x`: `un tuyau` (m., a pipe), `un jeu` (m., a game). Learn common exceptions taking `-s`: `un landau` (m., a pram), `un sarrau` (m., a smock), `un pneu` (m., a tyre), `un bleu` (m., a bruise).

Most nouns in `-al` replace `-al` with `-aux`: `un journal` (m., a newspaper) becomes `des journaux`. Common exceptions keep `-al` and add `-s`: `un bal`, `un carnaval`, `un festival`, `un récital`, `un régal`, `un chacal`, `un aval` (all masculine). These mean a dance, carnival, festival, recital, treat, jackal and approval. Do not apply `-al` rules to every `-ail` noun: `un détail` (m., a detail) gives `des détails`; `un travail` (m., a job or piece of work) has the irregular plural `des travaux`.
points: These families are spelling patterns, not a rule to add `x` to all nouns.
Learn an exception as a singular/plural pair.

examples.english: The newspapers talk about the festivals.
examples.note: The regular `-aux` family contrasts with an `-als` exception.

examples.english: The prams are in the corridor.

mistakes.why: `Pneu` is a common exception to the `-eu` + `x` pattern.

sections.title: An ordinary family name stays unchanged
paragraphs: When naming an ordinary family, make the article plural but leave the surname unchanged: `les Moreau` means the Moreau family. Do not add an English family-name -s. Certain established historical or dynastic names have conventional plurals, such as `les Bourbons`; learn these as special names rather than applying them to your neighbours.
points: An ordinary surname ending in `-eau` does not follow the common-noun `-eaux` rule.

examples.note: Plural reference is shown by `les` and the verb.

practice.prompt: Write the plural of 'une carte', including the indefinite article.
practice.explanation: Une becomes des and carte adds -s.

practice.prompt: Write only the plural of bateau.
Choose the plural of un festival.
Name the entire Martin family with les plus their surname.
Write only the plural of cadeau (gift).
Write only the plural of tuyau (pipe).
practice.explanation: This -au noun follows the usual -x pattern.

practice.prompt: Write only the plural of journal.
Write only the plural of jeu.
Write only the plural of landau.
The family's surname is Bernard. Rewrite the whole sentence, changing only the surname: 'Les Bernards sont ici.'
practice.explanation: Do not add -s to an ordinary surname.

practice.prompt: Which is the plural of une voix?
practice.explanation: A noun already ending in x stays unchanged.

practice.prompt: Write only the plural of bal (dance).
Write 'two tyres' using deux and the plural of pneu.
Write only the plural of travail.
practice.explanation: This is a useful irregular -ail plural.

practice.prompt: Write the plural of 'le nez' (nose), including the article.
practice.explanation: Le changes to les; a final z does not change.

practice.prompt: The surname is Rousseau. Choose the ordinary family name.
practice.explanation: The common-noun -eaux pattern does not apply to ordinary surnames.

production_task.prompt: Leave a short stock note mentioning several keys, games and newspapers. Then say which family has the newspapers; use a surname without changing it.
production_task.model_answer: Les clés et les jeux sont ici. Les Morel ont les journaux.
production_task.translation: The keys and games are here. The Morels have the newspapers.
